entities.summary: The murder of Eliyahu Asheri was an attack carried out on 25 June 2006, in which Palestinian Popular Resistance Committees (PRC) militants kidnapped, and later murdered the 18-year-old Israeli settler and high school student Eliyahu Asheri.
